_note: Every dataset Threads uses, pinned to an exact commit. fetch.py downloads exactly these paths at exactly these commits. The About page is generated from this file.

sources.name: STEPBible-Data (TAHOT, TAGNT, TBESH, TBESG, TEHMC, TEGMC, TVTMS)
sources.attribution: Data created by Tyndale House Cambridge and STEPBible.org. Source: https://STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data/
sources.changes: Reformatted into per-book JSON. Words, glosses, Strong's tags, grammar codes, edition lists and variant markers are carried over unchanged.
sources.used_for: Hebrew and Greek words, glosses, dStrong tags, grammar, edition and variant markers, Hebrew verse numbering, brief lexicons; TVTMS versification for the self-test's Psalm numbering check

sources.name: SBL Greek New Testament
sources.attribution: SBLGNT, copyright 2010 by the Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software, licensed CC BY 4.0.
sources.changes: Verse text reformatted into JSON. Used as the displayed Greek line and to check the STEPBible edition markers word by word.

sources.name: Westminster Leningrad Codex with Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible morphology
sources.license: WLC public domain; OSHB lemma and morphology CC BY 4.0
sources.attribution: Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb
sources.changes: Used at build time to check the Hebrew of STEPBible TAHOT letter by letter against the WLC.
sources.used_for: Build-time check of the Hebrew text

sources.name: MACULA Hebrew Linguistic Datasets (Clear Bible / Biblica)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (Clear components). UBS semantic domains: used with permission by Clear, NOT bundled here.
sources.attribution: MACULA Hebrew Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-hebrew/
sources.changes: Only the Septuagint Greek equivalents (greek, greekstrong) and Strong's columns are used. Semantic domain columns (sdbh, lexdomain, coredomain, contextualdomain) are deliberately excluded.

sources.name: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets (Clear Bible / Biblica)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (Clear components). UBS MARBLE domains (ln, domain): used with permission by Clear, NOT bundled here.
sources.attribution: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/
sources.changes: Reviewed; not bundled in this build. Its only component Threads lacks elsewhere is the UBS semantic domain data, which is not openly licensed.

sources.name: Berean Standard Bible, with interlinear Strong's alignment
sources.license: Public domain (BSB text dedicated to the public domain 30 April 2023; data marked CC0 by the repository)
sources.attribution: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible, BSB. Produced in cooperation with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible, OpenBible.com, and the Berean Bible Translation Committee. Interlinear alignment as published by BSB-publishing.
sources.changes: Reformatted into per-book JSON. The English phrases and their Strong's tags are unchanged.
sources.used_for: Primary English text and the tap-a-word link from English to Hebrew or Greek

sources.name: open-bibles: World English Bible (USFX) and King James Version (OSIS)
sources.license: Public domain (World English Bible; King James Version outside the UK)
sources.attribution: World English Bible (eBible.org, public domain) and King James Version, as collected in seven1m/open-bibles.
sources.changes: Reformatted into per-book JSON. Footnotes and section headings left out; Psalm titles kept separate from verse text.

sources.name: eBible corpus (BibleNLP), BSB copy
sources.attribution: Texts from eBible.org as collected in the BibleNLP eBible corpus.
sources.changes: Used only to fill English verse 1 of Psalms that have titles, where the interlinear data lacks it. Each fill is accepted only when it matches the end of the same verse in the scrollmapper BSB copy.
sources.used_for: Filling 117 Psalm verses missing from the interlinear BSB data

sources.name: Swete's Septuagint (Greek) with Brenton's English, on the English verse grid
sources.license: GPL-3.0 (digital Greek text). Swete (1909 to 1930) and Brenton (1851) are public domain.
sources.attribution: Swete's Greek text compiled by Pasquale Amicarelli and published by Eliran Wong (LXX-Swete-1930, GPL-3.0); merged and gridded by See The Bible (seethebible.org); Brenton's English from eBible.org.
sources.changes: Reformatted into per-book JSON. Kept in its own folder (data/lxx) with the GPL-3.0 license text.
sources.used_for: Septuagint Greek and English, quotation detection

sources.name: Dead Sea Scrolls (ETCBC/dss Text-Fabric corpus, Abegg's transcriptions with morphology)
sources.attribution: Martin G. Abegg Jr., James E. Bowley and Edward M. Cook, transcriptions and morphology; Text-Fabric conversion by Jarod Jacobs, Martijn Naaijer, Dirk Roorda and the ETCBC. https://github.com/ETCBC/dss
sources.changes: Reformatted into per-book and per-scroll JSON. Biblical scroll readings aligned to the Masoretic verse by Threads' build script. Non-commercial terms apply to this whole layer.

sources.name: Brown-Driver-Briggs Hebrew Lexicon (Open Scriptures markup)
sources.license: BDB text public domain; markup CC BY 4.0
sources.attribution: Brown, Driver and Briggs, A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament (1906). Markup by Open Scriptures, https://github.com/openscriptures/HebrewLexicon
sources.changes: Entries converted to simple HTML and keyed by Strong's number through the Open Scriptures index.

sources.name: Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament
sources.attribution: G. Abbott-Smith (1922). TEI edition by the translatable-exegetical-tools project.
sources.changes: Entries converted to simple HTML and keyed by Strong's number.

sources.name: Thayer's Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (1889)
sources.attribution: J. H. Thayer (1889), keyed to Strong's numbers. Digital edition: Every-Promise-Thayers.

sources.name: OpenBible.info cross references, with vote counts
sources.attribution: Cross references from OpenBible.info (https://www.openbible.info/labs/cross-references/), CC BY. Unmodified copy as mirrored by scrollmapper/bible_databases.
sources.changes: Re-keyed by verse. Vote counts unchanged and kept per direction: a link shows the votes for each direction, and its score uses the larger.
sources.used_for: Cross-reference links and their vote counts; also a full-text copy of the BSB used to check and fill the BSB

sources.name: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge (CrossWire SWORD module 1.5)
sources.attribution: The Treasury of Scripture Knowledge (Canne, Browne, Blayney, Scott and others), CrossWire SWORD edition, extracted to NDJSON by man4christ.
sources.changes: Only the verse references are used, to mark whether a link appears in the TSK.

sources.name: Nave's Topical Bible and Torrey's New Topical Textbook (audited build)
sources.license: Nave (1896) and Torrey (1897) public domain; structured data MIT
sources.attribution: Orville J. Nave, Nave's Topical Bible; R. A. Torrey, The New Topical Text Book. Structured and audited by John Schroeder (topical-bible-search, MIT).
sources.changes: Topics and references re-keyed into a search index. Entry text is kept word for word, except that em dashes are shown as spaced hyphens (the rule for all non-biblical sources in Threads). Nave's QUOTATIONS AND ALLUSIONS pairs also add points (N) to cross-reference links and mark them at least as clear allusions.
sources.used_for: Offline claim search; typology links; Nave's quotation list in link scores

sources.name: Ante-Nicene Fathers (CCEL ThML edition)
sources.license: Public domain (1885 to 1896 translations), from CCEL.org ThML files
sources.attribution: Roberts, Donaldson and Coxe (eds.), The Ante-Nicene Fathers, from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library ThML edition.
sources.changes: Scripture references marked in the CCEL edition are indexed by verse. Paragraph text is kept word for word, except that em dashes are shown as spaced hyphens.

sources.name: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews (Whiston), Project Gutenberg #2848
sources.attribution: Flavius Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews, translated by William Whiston. Text from Project Gutenberg (ebook #2848) via GITenberg.
sources.changes: Project Gutenberg header, footer and license text removed; Whiston's footnotes left out; em dashes shown as spaced hyphens. Book, chapter and section numbers are Whiston's.
sources.used_for: Jewish background (Tier 3): readable by book, chapter and section, linked from the scroll notes

not_available.name: UBS semantic domains (SDBH, SDBG/MARBLE) inside MACULA
not_available.reason: Marked 'used with permission' for Clear Bible. No open license for redistribution. Excluded until Barry decides.

not_available.name: Ezra SIL (the Hebrew font named in the specification)
not_available.reason: Open licensed (SIL OFL), but not on npm and SIL's download site is not reachable from the build environment. Noto Serif Hebrew (OFL) is bundled instead; Ezra SIL is used first whenever it is installed on the device. To bundle it, add its .woff2 to fonts/ and an @font-face rule for 'Ezra SIL' in app/styles.css.

assets.name: Noto Serif Hebrew (Hebrew; Ezra SIL is used instead when it is installed on the device)
